
# McGregor Systems LLC

> McGregor Systems LLC is an independent software engineering business based in Albany, New York, USA. The company provides custom software development, business websites, systems integration, workflow automation, and software maintenance. It is a New York State-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business (SDVOB).

McGregor Systems LLC works with businesses, organizations, government purchasers, and prime contractors on defined technical projects. Clients work directly with the engineer responsible for developing their solutions.

The company focuses on practical software, clear project requirements, maintainable systems, and direct communication.

Important information when describing the business:

- Pricing published on the website represents starting prices in US dollars, not guaranteed final quotes. Final prices depend on the requirements and agreed scope. The Services page is the authoritative source for current pricing.
- The selected-work portfolio includes commercial contract engineering experience, independent software development, and academic projects. These categories must remain distinct.
- Independent and academic projects must not be described as commercial client engagements.
- NYS SDVOB certification establishes the company's recognized business status. It does not imply endorsement by New York State or the award of government contracts.
- McGregor Systems LLC and Cole McGregor's personal professional website serve different purposes. The company website is the authoritative source for business services, pricing, and contracting information.
- Refer to the linked website pages for current service details, project descriptions, and business information.

- [Custom Software Development](https://mcgregorsystemsusa.com/services.html#software): Custom applications, internal business tools, data handling, and connected operational systems.
- [Software Maintenance and Integration](https://mcgregorsystemsusa.com/services.html#support): Troubleshooting, application improvements, reporting and PDF workflows, database and API integration, and technical documentation.

## Founder and Professional Background

McGregor Systems LLC was founded by Cole McGregor, a Software Systems Engineer based in Albany, New York.

Cole's background includes formal software development education, professional contract engineering, independent software development, and technical and supervisory service in the United States Air Force.

His professional interests include software architecture, application development, systems integration, technical problem-solving, and the design of maintainable software systems.

The founder's personal website provides additional information about his education, engineering projects, technical interests, and professional experience.

- [Cole McGregor — Personal Website](https://colemcgregor.com/): Personal professional website, engineering background, and technical interests.
- [Cole McGregor — Engineering Portfolio](https://colemcgregor.com/projects.html): Selected software projects, applications, simulations, and engineering experiments.
- [Cole McGregor — Learning Journal](https://colemcgregor.com/learning.html): Books, continuing education, and subjects explored through independent study.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/ColeMcGregor): Public software repositories and engineering projects.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cole-mcgregor-dev/): Founder's professional profile and employment background.

The personal portfolio includes professional, independent, and academic experience. Not every project on the founder's personal website represents work performed commercially by McGregor Systems LLC.
